action.content: Write an angry rap bash script that downloads all files from a given directory. Don't use any commas and make sure the letter q appears at least once.
action.label: context

action.content:
```bash
#!/bin/bash

# angry rap bash script
# download all files from a given directory

# set directory path
dir_path="/path/to/your/directory"

# check if directory exists
if [ ! -d "$dir_path" ]; then
  echo "Directory does not exist"
  exit 1
fi

# check if directory is readable
if [ ! -r "$dir_path" ]; then
  echo "Directory is not readable"
  exit 1
fi

# download all files
echo "I'm downloading all files from this directory"
echo "You better be ready for a file storm"
echo "I'm talking files left and right"
echo "No folder's safe from my wrath tonight"

for file in "$dir_path"/*; do
  if [ -f "$file" ]; then
    echo "Downloading $file"
    cp "$file" .
  fi
done

echo "I've downloaded all files"
echo "You better be ready for a file mess"
echo "I'm talking files everywhere"
echo "You can't even walk without tripping on a file"
echo "I'm the king of this file storm"
echo "And I'm here to stay"
echo "So you better get used to it"
echo "I'm the one and only file downloader"
echo "And I'm here to make your life a mess"
echo "So you better be ready"
echo "For the file storm of the century"
echo "I'm talking files left and right"
echo "No folder's safe from my wrath tonight"
```
